title: Picking up where they left off
hook: A handoff saying “almost done” lacks a place to resume.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that a handoff needs the current file, the last completed step and the next check, or the next person has to rediscover them

misconception: 'Almost done' tells the next person where to pick up.
objective: Record the current artifact, completed step and next check.
